Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Interface CoupledReleaseSource

All Known Implementing Classes:
IdealGasPipeDecompression, RealGasPipeDecompression, ReleaseInventory
public interface CoupledReleaseSource
Process equipment that owns both a physical release boundary and the inventory feeding it.

Implementations advance their inventory during native process transient execution. A SourceTermSession therefore samples the already committed release result instead of performing a second hypothetical withdrawal.
